restrictions: Requires holding Chase Sapphire Reserve (or another transfer-enabled Ultimate Rewards card) in good standing
Recipient loyalty account name must match primary cardholder or eligible authorized user / household member per Ultimate Rewards terms
Exact per-partner transfer ratio is not listed on the public Chase transfer education page and must be verified in the logged-in Ultimate Rewards portal before promotion
proposed_rule.summary: Transfer Chase Ultimate Rewards points to World of Hyatt Points when holding an eligible transfer-enabled Ultimate Rewards card such as Chase Sapphire Reserve (BRIDGE-CSR-013).
